liveProvider.note: The release is based on the fresh deployed v0.15.85 User Experience Design Studio ZIP/log audit, whose patched local regrade is 88/B with trusted UX false-friend source rows. A fresh deployed v0.15.86 package audit is required to verify quarantine in provider output.

claims.summary: The fresh v0.15.85 UX ZIP/log audit proves the new saved logs explain provider requests, responses, repair retries, compiler work, digest state, and the remaining source-trust failure.
User Experience source rows now need UX/design or concept-specific source anchors before becoming trusted concept-linked proof.
Weak UX false friends from source-finder and knowledge-resource inputs route to source review notes instead of trusted sourceLedger rows.
The deep quality grader mirrors the production UX source relevance gate and flags exported trusted false-friend rows as citation defects.

carryForward.next: After deploy, run a fresh v0.15.86 EduTool.dev ZIP/log audit and confirm UX false-friend rows are absent from trusted sourceLedger proof or appear only as source review notes.
Lesson 1 still fell back after two repair/retry calls, so enrichment recovery remains the next quality target after source trust is verified.
